title: Serving The True Guru, The Mind Becomes
summary: Ego is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure
source.lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.coreClaim: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure
evidence.turn: Keep returning to this turn: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name.
